items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: The interviewee only corrects the interviewer on the bass player's name ('Victor') in response to a story about Jimmy Jones subbing for Basie's band. No personal interaction or relationship between Clark Terry and Jimmy Jones is described.

ctx.x: Well when they catch you up there on a narcotics charge, then you’re not allowed back in, that’s all. Two of the guys had been through that. They shall be nameless, but like so now I get this phone call, and I said well, I’ll tell you what to do, call John Levy and tell John to get ahold of Jimmy Jones and the bass player, Sproles.
